consultantNotes: Malta's value is as a B2B supplier-licence hub and an EU base, not as a source of strict technical constraints. The technical constraint data here is the thinnest of the major markets.

A MGA licence does NOT imply the right to serve other EU markets. The Dutch Supreme Court ruling of 2026-07-03 on historical player-loss claims against Malta-licensed operators shows the cross-border legal exposure is real (MEDIUM).
Because so much is UNVERIFIED here, a Malta engagement should budget explicit time for retrieving MGA instruments rather than assuming the constraints are lax.
